data_quality.notes: Gold refresh: Volaris is fare/bundle/card driven: Zero is personal-item only, Basic includes a 15 kg checked bag but no carry-on, Plus includes carry-on and a 25 kg checked bag, and INVEX benefits have channel/cardholder/group/codeshare limits.

fees.conditions: Zero and Basic include only a personal item; Plus includes carry-on, and paid add-ons or INVEX benefits can add it

data_quality.notes: Volaris carry-on is not a universal free item. The fare family, More Baggage combo, and INVEX card benefit can change what is included.

fees.amount: Depends on fare bundle, route, and timing
fees.conditions: Basic includes one 15 kg checked bag, Plus includes one 25 kg bag, and extra bags are paid add-ons by timing/channel
fees.timing: at booking / manage booking / at airport

data_quality.notes: Volaris checked-bag pricing depends on fare family, route, timing, and add-ons. Included bags can be 15 kg or 25 kg by fare, while separately purchased checked bags use the 25 kg standard limit.

fees.conditions: INVEX baggage benefits require eligible card payment, cardholder travel, direct channel, non-group booking, and no codeshare
fees.applies_to: Eligible Volaris INVEX cardholders and companions

data_quality.notes: INVEX can be valuable, but it is not a blanket waiver: benefits depend on fare type, card type, cardholder travel, eligible channel, and reservation type.

fees.conditions: Overweight applies above purchased/included allowance; maximum accepted checked-bag weight is 45 kg including excess

data_quality.notes: Volaris publishes standard 25 kg checked-bag limits and a 45 kg absolute limit including excess; fee amounts sit in route/service fee tables.

fees.amount: Airport-priced by aircraft and handling limits
fees.conditions: Oversize applies above 158 linear cm; musical instruments and sports equipment use separate maximum dimensions and handling rules

fees.amount: Special baggage service or checked-bag replacement
fees.conditions: A purchased extra bag can be replaced by sports gear within limits; larger sports items use special baggage rules

data_quality.notes: Sports gear can either replace an added checked bag within standard limits or move into the special-equipment framework with higher dimension limits and possible extra fees.

fees.amount: Depends on seat type, fare bundle, route, and timing
fees.conditions: Seat selection cost depends on fare, seat type, route, and whether a bundle such as More Speed includes standard seats

data_quality.notes: Volaris bundles can include standard seat selection while excluding first row or emergency exit seats, so seat-fee exposure depends on the exact seat chosen.

fees.conditions: Flight changes permitted with applicable fee plus fare difference; cancellations generally not permitted except where explicitly allowed
Unaccompanied Minor service is not offered; minors must travel with an accompanying adult
Baby Combo adds a diaper bag and one documented infant item; price appears during booking and varies by season
fees.applies_to: Infants under 2 traveling with an adult

data_quality.note: Baby Combo is an optional add-on shown during booking; it covers one diaper bag up to 10 kg plus one documented infant item, and the price varies by travel season.
